body:
Ready for a re-check. New head `933e1774d` fixes the pre-review findings on `5b0ad957e`.

- `holder_files.rs`: the degenerate-input test `a_file_that_is_not_correct_is_refused_by_name_with_nothing_applied` has two new cases. A holder outline with a negative radius and a holder outline with fewer than 3 points are each refused. The refusal names the holder `'bt40-cyl20'`. The table and the history do not change.
- `holder_file_tools.rs`: `import_holders` does not use the built-in ids alone when the component library cannot be read. It refuses the import by name ("the component library is not read, so its ids are not kept clear"). `mcp_export_and_import_holders_use_the_one_command` pins this: an unreadable library refuses the import, and nothing is applied. The tool description and the row in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` name the new refusal.
- PR body, Gate section: the light lane result replaces "The light lane was not run".

Gate on `933e1774d` (one `lanes` run, log `gate-4463-933e1774d.log`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 394 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (`site tests` SKIPPED: no zola on the lane).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 4 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.

The PR stays a draft.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut.

This is the first collaborator review of this PR. It is a standard-tier review. The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry code. It adds holder rows to the document component table through one undoable command, and the existing `component_library::parse` checks each outline.

### What looks good

- `ImportHolders` (`crates/app/src/commands/holder_file.rs`) plans the import whole when it is made. It keeps one snapshot of the table before and one after, so any number of rows is one undo step. A refusal puts nothing into the history.
- A row that is not a holder, a file with no row, and each `parse` refusal stop the whole file by name. There is no partial import.
- The free-id loop uses `saturating_add` and has a finite set of taken ids. There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests.
- The UI buttons (`holders.rs`) and the MCP tools (`holder_file_tools.rs`) call the same `export_holders` function and the same `ImportHolders` command. `export_holders` asks for file-write approval in a live session (`mcp/live.rs`).
- The MCP import refuses when the component library cannot be read. This is the fix of the pre-review finding on `5b0ad957e`.
- The tests join existing suites: `tool_library_holders/holder_files.rs` (app) and `egui_app/tests/tool_library_holder_files.rs` (ui). The gate map names `app::commands (holder_file)` and `app::mcp (holder_file_tools)`.
- Each new module has a provenance line. The new files are under 400 lines. The decision record `docs/decisions/4389-holder-files.md` is present.
- The body has before and after screenshots on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The two files exist (`4463/before.png`, `4463/after.png`).
- The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #4389`. No process file, snapshot PNG, golden, `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs` or `.github/` file changes.

Extra suites run: none were due. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no importer code. No post, operation, motion or catalog file changes, so the example catalog suites do not apply. The heavy lanes do not apply.

I did not run the full 394-step quick plan on this host. The author's comment reports it green on this head (394 steps, 0 failed). The steps above are the binaries that the diff touches.

### Mutations (local, each restored after the run)

1. `holder_file.rs`: the not-a-holder refusal is removed. Result: red. `a_file_that_is_not_correct_is_refused_by_name_with_nothing_applied` fails at `holder_files.rs:120`.
2. `holder_file_tools.rs`: an unreadable library falls back to the built-in ids only. Result: red. `mcp_export_and_import_holders_use_the_one_command` fails at `holder_files.rs:174`.
3. `holder_file.rs`: the `row_refusal` check is removed. Result: green. This is correct: a library row has no cutter facts and no running data, so `row_refusal` cannot refuse an imported row. `parse` refuses the bad outlines (negative radius, fewer than 3 points) before this line. The check is defensive only.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Optional, non-blocking

1. `crates/ui/src/state_holder_files.rs:58`: the UI import uses `component_library().all` and does not read its `error`. When the user library cannot be read, `all` holds the built-in rows only, so a new id is kept clear of the built-in ids only. The MCP tool refuses this case. The UI "Copy as user" path (`state_components.rs:234`) has the same behaviour today, so this PR follows the existing UI pattern. A later fix can refuse the import, or show the library error, in the two UI paths together (suggested `P7`).
2. `crates/app/src/commands/holder_file.rs:97`: a file row keeps its file id when the id is free. A hand-made file with a free `builtin:` id gives a document row with a `builtin:` id. The export then skips that row. A rule can give a new `user:holder:` id to each `builtin:` id in the file (suggested `P7`).
3. The PR body says "This change adds no UI test", but the UI test count goes from 2019 to 2022 and the PR adds three UI tests. The wording can be corrected.
4. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (5211 lines) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs` (5495 lines) are already over the 400-line limit. This PR adds two module lines to each. This is not new growth of logic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
